duzuojingtingshan.src: 眾鳥高飛盡，孤雲獨去閑。
duzuojingtingshan.zh: 眾鳥高高飛走，消失得乾乾淨淨；一片孤雲獨自悠閒地飄去。
duzuojingtingshan.en: The flocks of birds have flown high and vanished; a lone cloud drifts away at leisure.
duzuojingtingshan.simp: 众鸟高高飞走，消失得干干净净；一片孤云独自悠闲地飘去。

duzuojingtingshan.src: 相看兩不厭，只有敬亭山。
duzuojingtingshan.zh: 我和敬亭山相互看著，彼此都看不厭，天地間只有這座敬亭山。
duzuojingtingshan.en: We look at each other and never tire - there is only Mount Jingting.
duzuojingtingshan.simp: 我和敬亭山相互看着，彼此都看不厌，天地间只有这座敬亭山。

qiufengyin.src: 何處秋風至，蕭蕭送鴈群。
qiufengyin.zh: 秋風是從哪裡吹來的？颯颯作響，送來一群群大雁。
qiufengyin.en: From where has the autumn wind come? Rustling, it sends a flock of wild geese.
qiufengyin.simp: 秋风是从哪里吹来的？飒飒作响，送来一群群大雁。

qiufengyin.src: 朝來入庭樹，孤客最先聞。
qiufengyin.zh: 清晨它吹進庭院的樹中，獨自作客在外的人最先聽到。
qiufengyin.en: At dawn it enters the trees in the courtyard, and the lonely traveller is the first to hear it.
qiufengyin.simp: 清晨它吹进庭院的树中，独自作客在外的人最先听到。

qiuyejiqiuyuanwai.src: 懷君屬秋夜，散步詠涼天。
qiuyejiqiuyuanwai.zh: 我正巧在這秋夜裡思念你，於是散步吟詠，面對涼爽的天氣。
qiuyejiqiuyuanwai.en: I think of you, as it happens, on this autumn night, strolling and chanting in the cool air.
qiuyejiqiuyuanwai.simp: 我正巧在这秋夜里思念你，于是散步吟咏，面对凉爽的天气。

qiuyejiqiuyuanwai.src: 空山松子落，幽人應未眠。
qiuyejiqiuyuanwai.zh: 空寂的山中松子正在掉落，隱居的你想必也還沒有睡。
qiuyejiqiuyuanwai.en: In the empty mountains pine cones are falling; you, the recluse, must surely be awake too.
qiuyejiqiuyuanwai.simp: 空寂的山中松子正在掉落，隐居的你想必也还没有睡。

yishuisongbie.src: 此地別燕丹，壯士髮衝冠。
yishuisongbie.zh: 荊軻就在這個地方告別了燕太子丹，壯士怒髮衝冠。
yishuisongbie.en: Here, at this place, Jing Ke took leave of Prince Dan of Yan, the brave man's hair bristling against his cap.
yishuisongbie.simp: 荆轲就在这个地方告别了燕太子丹，壮士怒发冲冠。

yishuisongbie.src: 昔時人已沒，今日水猶寒。
yishuisongbie.zh: 當年的人早已不在，今天易水的水仍然寒冷。
yishuisongbie.en: The men of that time are long gone, yet today the water of the Yi is still cold.
yishuisongbie.simp: 当年的人早已不在，今天易水的水仍然寒冷。

guosanlvmiao.src: 沅湘流不盡，屈宋怨何深。
guosanlvmiao.zh: 沅水和湘水流不盡，屈原和宋玉的怨憤是多麼深。
guosanlvmiao.en: The Yuan and Xiang rivers flow without end; how deep was the grief of Qu Yuan and Song Yu.
guosanlvmiao.simp: 沅水和湘水流不尽，屈原和宋玉的怨愤是多么深。

guosanlvmiao.src: 日暮秋煙起，蕭蕭楓樹林。
guosanlvmiao.zh: 日暮時分秋天的煙靄升起，楓樹林在風中蕭蕭作響。
guosanlvmiao.en: At dusk the autumn mist rises, and the maple woods rustle in the wind.
guosanlvmiao.simp: 日暮时分秋天的烟霭升起，枫树林在风中萧萧作响。

zhangganqu.src: 君家何處住？妾住在橫塘。
zhangganqu.zh: 你家住在哪裡？我家住在橫塘。
zhangganqu.en: Where is your home? I live at Hengtang.
zhangganqu.simp: 你家住在哪里？我家住在横塘。

zhangganqu.src: 停船暫借問，或恐是同鄉。
zhangganqu.zh: 停下船來暫且向你問一聲，或許我們是同鄉呢。
zhangganqu.en: I stop my boat to ask, for perhaps we come from the same place.
zhangganqu.simp: 停下船来暂且向你问一声，或许我们是同乡呢。

qiupuge.src: 白髮三千丈，離愁似箇長。
qiupuge.zh: 白髮長達三千丈，離愁就像這樣長。
qiupuge.en: My white hair is three thousand feet long; my sorrow of parting is as long as that.
qiupuge.simp: 白发长达三千丈，离愁就像这样长。

qiupuge.src: 不知明鏡裡，何處惹秋霜。
qiupuge.zh: 不知道明亮的鏡子裡，是從哪裡招來這一頭秋霜。
qiupuge.en: I do not know where in the bright mirror this autumn frost has come from.
qiupuge.simp: 不知道明亮的镜子里，是从哪里招来这一头秋霜。

songguosicang.src: 映門淮水綠，留騎主人心。
songguosicang.zh: 淮水碧綠，映照著門前；主人留客的心意很深。
songguosicang.en: The green Huai waters glimmer at the gate; the host's heart wishes to keep his guest's horse.
songguosicang.simp: 淮水碧绿，映照着门前；主人留客的心意很深。

songguosicang.src: 明月隨良掾，春潮夜夜深。
songguosicang.zh: 明月將跟隨著這位好官員，春天的潮水夜夜漲得更深。
songguosicang.en: The bright moon will follow this fine official, and the spring tide will rise deeper night after night.
songguosicang.simp: 明月将跟随着这位好官员，春天的潮水夜夜涨得更深。

yongshi.src: 尚有綈袍贈，應憐范叔寒。
yongshi.zh: 他尚且還贈送了一件綈袍，大概是可憐范叔的寒冷。
yongshi.en: He still gave him a coarse silk robe, out of pity, it seems, for Fan Sui's cold.
yongshi.simp: 他尚且还赠送了一件绨袍，大概是可怜范叔的寒冷。

yongshi.src: 不知天下士，猶作布衣看。
yongshi.zh: 他不知道眼前就是天下的賢士，仍把他當作一個平民看待。
yongshi.en: He did not know that this was a worthy of the realm, and still saw him as a commoner.
yongshi.simp: 他不知道眼前就是天下的贤士，仍把他当作一个平民看待。

songyourenrushu.src: 見說蠶叢路，崎嶇不易行。
songyourenrushu.zh: 聽說去蜀地的蠶叢之路，崎嶇不平，不容易行走。
songyourenrushu.en: I hear that the road to Shu, land of Cancong, is rough and hard to travel.
songyourenrushu.simp: 听说去蜀地的蚕丛之路，崎岖不平，不容易行走。

songyourenrushu.src: 山從人面起，雲傍馬頭生。
songyourenrushu.zh: 山好像從人的臉旁升起，雲彩緊靠著馬頭生出。
songyourenrushu.en: Mountains rise up in front of people's faces, and clouds form beside the horses' heads.
songyourenrushu.simp: 山好像从人的脸旁升起，云彩紧靠着马头生出。

songyourenrushu.src: 芳樹籠秦棧，春流遶蜀城。
songyourenrushu.zh: 芬芳的樹木籠罩著秦地的棧道，春天的流水環繞著蜀地的城。
songyourenrushu.en: Fragrant trees cover the plank roads of Qin, and spring streams wind around the city of Shu.
songyourenrushu.simp: 芬芳的树木笼罩着秦地的栈道，春天的流水环绕着蜀地的城。

songyourenrushu.src: 升沉應已定，不必問君平。
songyourenrushu.zh: 你的升沉榮辱大概早已命定，不必再去請教嚴君平這樣的卜者。
songyourenrushu.en: Your rise or fall is surely already fixed; there is no need to ask a diviner like Yan Junping.
songyourenrushu.simp: 你的升沉荣辱大概早已命定，不必再去请教严君平这样的卜者。

chunsuzuosheng.src: 花隱掖垣暮，啾啾棲鳥過。
chunsuzuosheng.zh: 傍晚花影隱在門下省的旁牆邊，啾啾鳴叫的鳥兒飛過去歇宿。
chunsuzuosheng.en: Dusk, and the flowers hide by the side wall of the Secretariat; chirping birds pass over to roost.
chunsuzuosheng.simp: 傍晚花影隐在门下省的旁墙边，啾啾鸣叫的鸟儿飞过去歇宿。

chunsuzuosheng.src: 星臨萬戶動，月傍九霄多。
chunsuzuosheng.zh: 星星臨照著千門萬戶，微微閃動；月亮靠近高空，月光特別多。
chunsuzuosheng.en: Stars shine over ten thousand doors and seem to stir; the moon, close to the high sky, gives plenty of light.
chunsuzuosheng.simp: 星星临照着千门万户，微微闪动；月亮靠近高空，月光特别多。

chunsuzuosheng.src: 不寢聽金鑰，因風想玉珂。
chunsuzuosheng.zh: 我不能入睡，聽著宮門的金鑰匙聲，又順著風聲想像上朝官員的玉珂聲。
chunsuzuosheng.en: Sleepless, I listen for the golden keys of the gates, and in the wind imagine the jade bridle-bells of officials.
chunsuzuosheng.simp: 我不能入睡，听着宫门的金钥匙声，又顺着风声想像上朝官员的玉珂声。

chunsuzuosheng.src: 明朝有封事，數問夜如何。
chunsuzuosheng.zh: 明天早上有密封的奏章要上呈，因此幾次詢問夜裡到了什麼時辰。
chunsuzuosheng.en: Tomorrow morning there is a sealed memorial to present, so I keep asking how far the night has gone.
chunsuzuosheng.simp: 明天早上有密封的奏章要上呈，因此几次询问夜里到了什么时辰。

dengyanzhouchenglou.src: 東郡趨庭日，南樓縱目初。
dengyanzhouchenglou.zh: 當年我到東郡去探望父親，初次登上南城樓放眼遠望。
dengyanzhouchenglou.en: In the days I visited my father in Dongjun, I first climbed the south tower and gazed far.
dengyanzhouchenglou.simp: 当年我到东郡去探望父亲，初次登上南城楼放眼远望。

dengyanzhouchenglou.src: 浮雲連海岳，平野人青徐。
dengyanzhouchenglou.zh: 浮雲連著大海和山嶽，平坦的原野伸入青州和徐州。
dengyanzhouchenglou.en: Floating clouds join the sea and the mountains; the flat plain runs into Qing and Xu.
dengyanzhouchenglou.simp: 浮云连着大海和山岳，平坦的原野伸入青州和徐州。

dengyanzhouchenglou.src: 孤嶂秦碑在，荒城魯殿餘。
dengyanzhouchenglou.zh: 孤立的山峰上還有秦代的石碑，荒涼的城中還剩下魯王的宮殿遺跡。
dengyanzhouchenglou.en: On a lone peak stands a stele of Qin; in the ruined city remains the hall of the Prince of Lu.
dengyanzhouchenglou.simp: 孤立的山峰上还有秦代的石碑，荒凉的城中还剩下鲁王的宫殿遗迹。

dengyanzhouchenglou.src: 從來多古意，臨眺獨躊躇。
dengyanzhouchenglou.zh: 這裡向來多有懷古的意味，我臨高眺望，獨自徘徊不前。
dengyanzhouchenglou.en: This place has always held a feeling of the ancient past; looking out from the height, I linger alone.
dengyanzhouchenglou.simp: 这里向来多有怀古的意味，我临高眺望，独自徘徊不前。

poshansihouchanyuan.src: 清晨入古寺，初日照高林。
poshansihouchanyuan.zh: 清晨走進古老的寺院，初升的陽光照耀著高高的樹林。
poshansihouchanyuan.en: At dawn I enter the old temple, where the first sun lights the tall trees.
poshansihouchanyuan.simp: 清晨走进古老的寺院，初升的阳光照耀着高高的树林。

poshansihouchanyuan.src: 曲徑通幽處，禪房花木深。
poshansihouchanyuan.zh: 彎曲的小路通向幽深之處，禪房四周花木繁茂。
poshansihouchanyuan.en: A winding path leads to a secluded spot; around the meditation rooms flowers and trees grow deep.
poshansihouchanyuan.simp: 弯曲的小路通向幽深之处，禅房四周花木繁茂。

poshansihouchanyuan.src: 山光悅鳥性，潭影空人心。
poshansihouchanyuan.zh: 山色使鳥兒的性情愉悅，潭水中的倒影使人心澄淨空明。
poshansihouchanyuan.en: The mountain light delights the birds, and the reflection in the pool empties the heart.
poshansihouchanyuan.simp: 山色使鸟儿的性情愉悦，潭水中的倒影使人心澄净空明。

poshansihouchanyuan.src: 萬籟此俱寂，惟聞鐘磬音。
poshansihouchanyuan.zh: 萬般聲響在這裡都歸於寂靜，只聽得鐘聲和磬聲。
poshansihouchanyuan.en: All the sounds of the world fall silent here; only the bell and chime can be heard.
poshansihouchanyuan.simp: 万般声响在这里都归于寂静，只听得钟声和磬声。

yewang.src: 東皐薄暮望，徙倚欲何依。
yewang.zh: 傍晚時分在東皋眺望，我徘徊不定，不知可以依靠什麼。
yewang.en: In the dusk I gaze from the eastern hill, pacing about, with nothing to lean on.
yewang.simp: 傍晚时分在东皋眺望，我徘徊不定，不知可以依靠什么。

yewang.src: 樹樹皆秋色，山山唯落暉。
yewang.zh: 每一棵樹都染著秋色，每一座山都只剩落日的餘暉。
yewang.en: Every tree has autumn colour, every hill holds only the setting light.
yewang.simp: 每一棵树都染着秋色，每一座山都只剩落日的余晖。

yewang.src: 牧人驅犢返，獵馬帶禽歸。
yewang.zh: 牧人趕著小牛回來，獵人的馬馱著獵到的禽鳥歸去。
yewang.en: Herdsmen drive their calves home, and hunters' horses come back with birds.
yewang.simp: 牧人赶着小牛回来，猎人的马驮着猎到的禽鸟归去。

yewang.src: 相顧無相識，長歌懷采薇。
yewang.zh: 我們彼此相望，卻沒有一個相識的人，我只能長歌，懷念採薇的伯夷、叔齊。
yewang.en: We look at one another, none a friend; I sing long, thinking of those who picked the bracken.
yewang.simp: 我们彼此相望，却没有一个相识的人，我只能长歌，怀念采薇的伯夷、叔齐。

qiudengxuanchengxietiaobeilou.src: 江城如畫裏，山曉望晴空。
qiudengxuanchengxietiaobeilou.zh: 江邊的城像在畫裡一樣，清晨站在山上眺望晴朗的天空。
qiudengxuanchengxietiaobeilou.en: The river town lies as if in a painting; in the morning I look up at a clear sky from the hills.
qiudengxuanchengxietiaobeilou.simp: 江边的城像在画里一样，清晨站在山上眺望晴朗的天空。

qiudengxuanchengxietiaobeilou.src: 兩水夾明鏡，雙橋落彩虹。
qiudengxuanchengxietiaobeilou.zh: 兩條河水夾著明鏡般的水面，兩座橋像彩虹落在水上。
qiudengxuanchengxietiaobeilou.en: Two rivers hold the bright mirror between them, and two bridges fall like rainbows across the water.
qiudengxuanchengxietiaobeilou.simp: 两条河水夹着明镜般的水面，两座桥像彩虹落在水上。

qiudengxuanchengxietiaobeilou.src: 人煙寒橘柚，秋色老梧桐。
qiudengxuanchengxietiaobeilou.zh: 人家的炊煙使橘樹柚樹顯得清冷，秋色使梧桐顯得蒼老。
qiudengxuanchengxietiaobeilou.en: Smoke from the houses chills the orange and pomelo trees, and the autumn colour ages the parasol trees.
qiudengxuanchengxietiaobeilou.simp: 人家的炊烟使橘树柚树显得清冷，秋色使梧桐显得苍老。

qiudengxuanchengxietiaobeilou.src: 誰念北樓上，臨風懷謝公。
qiudengxuanchengxietiaobeilou.zh: 誰會想到在北樓上，我迎著風在懷念謝公呢？
qiudengxuanchengxietiaobeilou.en: Who would think that on the north tower, facing the wind, I am thinking of Lord Xie?
qiudengxuanchengxietiaobeilou.simp: 谁会想到在北楼上，我迎着风在怀念谢公呢？

guoxiangjisi.src: 不知香積寺，數里入雲峰。
guoxiangjisi.zh: 不知道香積寺在哪裡，走了幾里路就進入雲霧繚繞的山峰。
guoxiangjisi.en: I do not know where Xiangji Temple is; after some miles I enter peaks among the clouds.
guoxiangjisi.simp: 不知道香积寺在哪里，走了几里路就进入云雾缭绕的山峰。

guoxiangjisi.src: 古木無人徑，深山何處鐘？
guoxiangjisi.zh: 古老的樹林間沒有人走的小路，深山裡是哪裡傳來的鐘聲？
guoxiangjisi.en: Among old trees there is no path of men; from where in the deep mountains comes the bell?
guoxiangjisi.simp: 古老的树林间没有人走的小路，深山里是哪里传来的钟声？

guoxiangjisi.src: 泉聲咽危石，日色冷青松。
guoxiangjisi.zh: 泉水在險峻的石間發出嗚咽般的聲音，日光照在青松上顯得清冷。
guoxiangjisi.en: The spring sobs over the steep rocks, and the sunlight on the green pines looks cold.
guoxiangjisi.simp: 泉水在险峻的石间发出呜咽般的声音，日光照在青松上显得清冷。

guoxiangjisi.src: 薄暮空潭曲，安禪制毒龍。
guoxiangjisi.zh: 傍晚在空寂的潭水邊，我安心禪坐，制伏心中的毒龍。
guoxiangjisi.en: At dusk by the bend of the empty pool, I sit in meditation and subdue the poison dragon of the mind.
guoxiangjisi.simp: 傍晚在空寂的潭水边，我安心禅坐，制伏心中的毒龙。

tixuanwuchanshiwubi.src: 何年顧虎頭，滿壁畫滄州。
tixuanwuchanshiwubi.zh: 是哪一年請顧虎頭來，在滿牆畫上了滄洲景色？
tixuanwuchanshiwubi.en: In what year did Gu Kaizhi come to paint the whole wall with the scenes of Cangzhou?
tixuanwuchanshiwubi.simp: 是哪一年请顾虎头来，在满墙画上了沧洲景色？

tixuanwuchanshiwubi.src: 赤日石林氣，青天江海流。
tixuanwuchanshiwubi.zh: 紅日照著石林散發的氣息，青天下江海奔流。
tixuanwuchanshiwubi.en: Red sun on the breath of the stone forest; beneath the blue sky rivers and seas flow.
tixuanwuchanshiwubi.simp: 红日照着石林散发的气息，青天下江海奔流。

tixuanwuchanshiwubi.src: 錫飛常近鶴，杯渡不驚鷗。
tixuanwuchanshiwubi.zh: 飛錫的僧人常常靠近仙鶴，渡水的杯子不驚動海鷗。
tixuanwuchanshiwubi.en: The monk's flying staff is often near the cranes, and his floating cup does not startle the gulls.
tixuanwuchanshiwubi.simp: 飞锡的僧人常常靠近仙鹤，渡水的杯子不惊动海鸥。

tixuanwuchanshiwubi.src: 似得廬山路，真隨惠遠遊。
tixuanwuchanshiwubi.zh: 好像找到了通往廬山的路，真的追隨慧遠遊覽一般。
tixuanwuchanshiwubi.en: It is as if I had found the road to Mount Lu, and truly followed Huiyuan on his wanderings.
tixuanwuchanshiwubi.simp: 好像找到了通往庐山的路，真的追随慧远游览一般。

jizuoshengdushiyi.src: 聯步趨丹陛，分曹限紫微。
jizuoshengdushiyi.zh: 我們並肩快步走向宮殿的紅色台階，又分屬不同的官署，我在中書省，你在門下省。
jizuoshengdushiyi.en: Side by side we hurry up the red palace steps, then part into separate offices, I in the Zhongshu Secretariat and you in the Chancellery.
jizuoshengdushiyi.simp: 我们并肩快步走向宫殿的红色台阶，又分属不同的官署，我在中书省，你在门下省。

jizuoshengdushiyi.src: 曉隨天仗入，暮惹御香歸。
jizuoshengdushiyi.zh: 早晨隨著皇帝的儀仗進宮，傍晚帶著御爐的香氣回來。
jizuoshengdushiyi.en: In the morning we enter with the emperor's guard; at dusk we return with the scent of the royal incense.
jizuoshengdushiyi.simp: 早晨随着皇帝的仪仗进宫，傍晚带着御炉的香气回来。

jizuoshengdushiyi.src: 白髮悲花落，青雲羨鳥飛。
jizuoshengdushiyi.zh: 白髮的我為花落而悲嘆，羨慕青雲間飛翔的鳥。
jizuoshengdushiyi.en: With white hair I grieve over falling blossoms, and envy the birds flying through the blue clouds.
jizuoshengdushiyi.simp: 白发的我为花落而悲叹，羡慕青云间飞翔的鸟。

jizuoshengdushiyi.src: 聖朝無闕事，自覺諫書稀。
jizuoshengdushiyi.zh: 聖明的朝廷沒有缺失之事，我自覺諫書也很少了。
jizuoshengdushiyi.en: The wise court has no flaws to mend, and I find myself writing few remonstrances.
jizuoshengdushiyi.simp: 圣明的朝廷没有缺失之事，我自觉谏书也很少了。

suyunmensige.src: 香閣東山下，煙花象外幽。
suyunmensige.zh: 香火繚繞的樓閣在東山腳下，煙霧和花朵在塵世之外顯得幽靜。
suyunmensige.en: The fragrant pavilion stands at the foot of Eastern Mountain; mist and flowers are secluded beyond the world.
suyunmensige.simp: 香火缭绕的楼阁在东山脚下，烟雾和花朵在尘世之外显得幽静。

suyunmensige.src: 懸燈千嶂夕，卷幔五湖秋。
suyunmensige.zh: 傍晚千重山嶂間懸起燈火，卷起帷幔，看見五湖的秋色。
suyunmensige.en: At dusk lamps hang among a thousand peaks; I roll up the curtain to see the autumn of the Five Lakes.
suyunmensige.simp: 傍晚千重山嶂间悬起灯火，卷起帷幔，看见五湖的秋色。

suyunmensige.src: 畫壁餘鴻鴈，紗窓宿斗牛。
suyunmensige.zh: 畫壁上殘留著鴻雁的圖影，紗窗外是斗宿和牛宿的星辰。
suyunmensige.en: On the painted wall remain pictures of wild geese; beyond the gauze window rest the stars of Dipper and Ox.
suyunmensige.simp: 画壁上残留着鸿雁的图影，纱窗外是斗宿和牛宿的星辰。

suyunmensige.src: 更疑天路近，夢與白雲遊。
suyunmensige.zh: 我更疑心天路很近，夢中和白雲一起遨遊。
suyunmensige.en: I even suspect the road to heaven is near, and in dreams I wander with the white clouds.
suyunmensige.simp: 我更疑心天路很近，梦中和白云一起遨游。

wangqinchuan.src: 秦川朝望迥，日出正東峰。
wangqinchuan.zh: 清晨遠望秦川，視野遼遠，太陽正從東面的山峰升起。
wangqinchuan.en: In the morning I gaze far over the Qin plain, where the sun rises over the eastern peaks.
wangqinchuan.simp: 清晨远望秦川，视野辽远，太阳正从东面的山峰升起。

wangqinchuan.src: 遠近山河淨，逶迤城闕重。
wangqinchuan.zh: 遠近的山河都潔淨清朗，曲折的城闕層層重疊。
wangqinchuan.en: Near and far, hills and rivers are clean and clear; winding walls and towers lie layer on layer.
wangqinchuan.simp: 远近的山河都洁净清朗，曲折的城阙层层重叠。

wangqinchuan.src: 秋聲萬戶竹，寒色五陵松。
wangqinchuan.zh: 千家萬戶的竹子發出秋天的聲音，五個皇陵的松樹顯出寒意。
wangqinchuan.en: In ten thousand households the bamboo makes an autumn sound, and the pines at the five imperial tombs look cold.
wangqinchuan.simp: 千家万户的竹子发出秋天的声音，五个皇陵的松树显出寒意。

wangqinchuan.src: 客有歸歟歎，悽其霜露濃。
wangqinchuan.zh: 旅居的人發出「歸去吧」的嘆息，心中悽愴，霜露又濃重。
wangqinchuan.en: The traveller sighs 'let me go home'; his heart is heavy, and the frost and dew are thick.
wangqinchuan.simp: 旅居的人发出「归去吧」的叹息，心中凄怆，霜露又浓重。

chunrioucheng.src: 雲淡風輕近午天，傍花隨柳過前川。
chunrioucheng.zh: 雲淡風輕，已近中午，我傍著花、隨著柳樹，走過前面的河川。
chunrioucheng.en: Clouds are thin and the breeze light, near noon; I follow flowers and willows across the stream ahead.
chunrioucheng.simp: 云淡风轻，已近中午，我傍着花、随着柳树，走过前面的河川。

chunrioucheng.src: 時人不識予心樂，將謂偷閑學少年。
chunrioucheng.zh: 當時的人不明白我心中的快樂，還以為我是偷閒學少年人的樣子。
chunrioucheng.en: People of the day do not understand the joy in my heart, and think I am stealing leisure to play the youth.
chunrioucheng.simp: 当时的人不明白我心中的快乐，还以为我是偷闲学少年人的样子。

chunri.src: 勝日尋芳泗水濱，無邊光景一時新。
chunri.zh: 在晴好的日子到泗水邊尋訪春天的芳景，無邊的風光一下子煥然一新。
chunri.en: On a fine day I seek the scents of spring by the Si River; the boundless view is suddenly made new.
chunri.simp: 在晴好的日子到泗水边寻访春天的芳景，无边的风光一下子焕然一新。

chunri.src: 等閒識得東風面，萬紫千紅總是春。
chunri.zh: 隨隨便便就認出了東風的面貌：萬紫千紅，都是春天。
chunri.en: Without effort I recognize the face of the east wind: ten thousand purples and reds are all spring.
chunri.simp: 随随便便就认出了东风的面貌：万紫千红，都是春天。

chunxiao.src: 春宵一刻值千金，花有清香月有陰。
chunxiao.zh: 春天的夜晚，一刻值千金，花有清香，月有朦朧的影子。
chunxiao.en: A moment of a spring night is worth a thousand pieces of gold; the flowers give a clear scent, and the moon casts a shade.
chunxiao.simp: 春天的夜晚，一刻值千金，花有清香，月有朦胧的影子。

chunxiao.src: 歌管樓臺聲細細，鞦韆院落夜沉沉。
chunxiao.zh: 樓臺上的歌聲和管弦聲細細傳來，院子裡的鞦韆靜靜地立在深沉的夜色中。
chunxiao.en: From the pavilions song and pipes sound faintly; in the courtyard the swing hangs still in the deep night.
chunxiao.simp: 楼台上的歌声和管弦声细细传来，院子里的秋千静静地立在深沉的夜色中。

chunye.src: 金爐香燼漏聲殘，剪剪輕風陣陣寒。
chunye.zh: 金爐裡的香已燒成灰燼，滴漏的聲音將盡，一陣陣輕風帶來寒意。
chunye.en: The incense in the gold burner is ash, the water-clock is nearly spent, and gusts of light wind bring a chill.
chunye.simp: 金炉里的香已烧成灰烬，滴漏的声音将尽，一阵阵轻风带来寒意。

chunye.src: 春色惱人眠不得，月移花影上欄桿。
chunye.zh: 春色擾得人睡不著，月亮移動，花影爬上了欄杆。
chunye.en: The beauty of spring keeps me from sleep; the moon moves on, and the shadows of the flowers climb the rail.
chunye.simp: 春色扰得人睡不着，月亮移动，花影爬上了栏杆。

yuanri.src: 爆竹聲中一歲除，春風送暖入屠蘇。
yuanri.zh: 在爆竹聲中送走了一年，春風送來溫暖，吹進屠蘇酒中。
yuanri.en: Amid the crackle of firecrackers the old year is gone; the spring wind brings warmth into the Tusu wine.
yuanri.simp: 在爆竹声中送走了一年，春风送来温暖，吹进屠苏酒中。

yuanri.src: 千門萬戶曈曈日，總把新桃換舊符。
yuanri.zh: 千家萬戶都迎著初升的朝陽，人人都把舊的桃符換成新的。
yuanri.en: On ten thousand doors the morning sun shines bright, and everyone swaps the old peach-wood charms for new.
yuanri.simp: 千家万户都迎着初升的朝阳，人人都把旧的桃符换成新的。

lichunoucheng.src: 律回歲晚冰霜少，春到人間草木知。
lichunoucheng.zh: 節律已經回轉，年尾冰霜減少，春天到了人間，草木最先知道。
lichunoucheng.en: The seasons have turned, the year is late and frost is less; spring has come to the world and plants and trees know it first.
lichunoucheng.simp: 节律已经回转，年尾冰霜减少，春天到了人间，草木最先知道。

lichunoucheng.src: 便覺眼前生意滿，東風吹水綠參差。
lichunoucheng.zh: 頓時覺得眼前滿是生機，東風吹拂水面，綠波高低不齊。
lichunoucheng.en: At once I feel life everywhere before my eyes; the east wind stirs the water into uneven green.
lichunoucheng.simp: 顿时觉得眼前满是生机，东风吹拂水面，绿波高低不齐。

jiangnanchun.src: 千里鶯啼綠映紅，水村山郭酒旗風。
jiangnanchun.zh: 千里之間黃鶯啼叫，綠葉映著紅花，水邊村莊和山邊城郭都飄著酒旗。
jiangnanchun.en: For a thousand li orioles sing, green sets off red; in water villages and hill towns wine-flags flutter in the wind.
jiangnanchun.simp: 千里之间黄莺啼叫，绿叶映着红花，水边村庄和山边城郭都飘着酒旗。

jiangnanchun.src: 南朝四百八十寺，多少樓臺煙雨中。
jiangnanchun.zh: 南朝留下了四百八十座寺廟，多少樓臺都籠罩在煙雨之中。
jiangnanchun.en: The Southern dynasties left four hundred and eighty temples; how many towers stand in the misty rain.
jiangnanchun.simp: 南朝留下了四百八十座寺庙，多少楼台都笼罩在烟雨之中。

xiadihoushangyongchonggaoshilang.src: 天上碧桃和露種，日邊紅杏倚雲栽。
xiadihoushangyongchonggaoshilang.zh: 天上的碧桃帶著露水種下，太陽旁的紅杏靠著雲彩栽培。
xiadihoushangyongchonggaoshilang.en: The green peach in heaven is planted with dew, the red apricot by the sun is raised on the clouds.
xiadihoushangyongchonggaoshilang.simp: 天上的碧桃带着露水种下，太阳旁的红杏靠着云彩栽培。

xiadihoushangyongchonggaoshilang.src: 芙蓉生在秋江上，不向東風怨未開。
xiadihoushangyongchonggaoshilang.zh: 芙蓉長在秋天的江上，不向東風抱怨自己沒有開花。
xiadihoushangyongchonggaoshilang.en: The lotus grows on the autumn river and does not blame the east wind that it has not bloomed.
xiadihoushangyongchonggaoshilang.simp: 芙蓉长在秋天的江上，不向东风抱怨自己没有开花。

youyuanbuzhi.src: 應憐屐齒印蒼苔，小扣柴扉久不開。
youyuanbuzhi.zh: 想必是怕木屐的齒痕踩壞了青苔，我輕輕敲了很久柴門也沒有人開。
youyuanbuzhi.en: Perhaps he fears my clogs will mark the green moss; I tap the brushwood gate softly for a long time and no one opens.
youyuanbuzhi.simp: 想必是怕木屐的齿痕踩坏了青苔，我轻轻敲了很久柴门也没有人开。

youyuanbuzhi.src: 春色滿園關不住，一支紅杏出牆來。
youyuanbuzhi.zh: 滿園的春色關不住，一枝紅杏伸出牆來。
youyuanbuzhi.en: The spring in the whole garden cannot be shut in; a branch of red apricot reaches out over the wall.
youyuanbuzhi.simp: 满园的春色关不住，一枝红杏伸出墙来。

kezhonghang.src: 蘭陵美酒鬱金香，玉碗盛來琥珀光。
kezhonghang.zh: 蘭陵的美酒帶著鬱金香的香氣，用玉碗盛來，閃著琥珀的光澤。
kezhonghang.en: The fine wine of Lanling smells of turmeric flowers; served in a jade bowl, it shines like amber.
kezhonghang.simp: 兰陵的美酒带着郁金香的香气，用玉碗盛来，闪着琥珀的光泽。

kezhonghang.src: 但使主人能醉客，不知何處是他鄉。
kezhonghang.zh: 只要主人能讓客人喝醉，我就不知道哪裡是他鄉了。
kezhonghang.en: If only the host can make his guest drunk, I will not know which place is a foreign land.
kezhonghang.simp: 只要主人能让客人喝醉，我就不知道哪里是他乡了。

jueju.src: 古木陰中繫短篷，杖藜扶我過橋東。
jueju.zh: 在古樹的濃蔭下繫好小船，拄著藜杖扶我走過橋東。
jueju.en: Under the shade of an old tree I moor my small boat, and lean on a goosefoot staff to cross to the east of the bridge.
jueju.simp: 在古树的浓荫下系好小船，拄着藜杖扶我走过桥东。

jueju.src: 沾衣欲濕杏花雨，吹面不寒楊柳風。
jueju.zh: 杏花的細雨彷彿要沾濕衣裳，楊柳的春風吹在臉上並不覺得寒冷。
jueju.en: The apricot-blossom rain seems about to wet my clothes; the willow wind on my face is not cold.
jueju.simp: 杏花的细雨仿佛要沾湿衣裳，杨柳的春风吹在脸上并不觉得寒冷。

xuandouguantaohua.src: 紫陌紅塵拂面來，無人不道看花回。
xuandouguantaohua.zh: 紫色大道上，紅色塵土撲面而來，沒有人不說是看花回來。
xuandouguantaohua.en: On the purple avenue red dust blows in my face, and everyone says they are back from seeing the flowers.
xuandouguantaohua.simp: 紫色大道上，红色尘土扑面而来，没有人不说是看花回来。

xuandouguantaohua.src: 玄都觀裏桃千樹，盡是劉郎去後栽。
xuandouguantaohua.zh: 玄都觀裡的上千棵桃樹，全是我劉郎離去之後栽種的。
xuandouguantaohua.en: The thousand peach trees in Xuandu Temple were all planted after Master Liu left.
xuandouguantaohua.simp: 玄都观里的上千棵桃树，全是我刘郎离去之后栽种的。

zaiyouxuandouguan.src: 百畝庭中半是苔，桃花淨盡菜花開。
zaiyouxuandouguan.zh: 百畝的庭院中有一半長滿了青苔，桃花全都沒有了，只有菜花在開。
zaiyouxuandouguan.en: In the hundred-mu courtyard half is moss; the peach blossoms are all gone and only cabbage flowers bloom.
zaiyouxuandouguan.simp: 百亩的庭院中有一半长满了青苔，桃花全都没有了，只有菜花在开。

zaiyouxuandouguan.zh: 那種桃樹的道士到哪裡去了？
zaiyouxuandouguan.en: Where has the Daoist who planted the peaches gone?
zaiyouxuandouguan.simp: 那种桃树的道士到哪里去了？

zaiyouxuandouguan.zh: 從前來過的劉郎，今天又來了。
zaiyouxuandouguan.en: Master Liu, who came before, has come again today.
zaiyouxuandouguan.simp: 从前来过的刘郎，今天又来了。

qingming.src: 清明時節雨紛紛，路上行人欲斷魂。
qingming.zh: 清明時節，雨紛紛落下，路上的行人心神黯然，好像要斷魂一般。
qingming.en: At Qingming the rain falls thick and soft, and travellers on the road feel their spirits would break.
qingming.simp: 清明时节，雨纷纷落下，路上的行人心神黯然，好像要断魂一般。

qingming.en: May I ask, where is there a wine shop?

qingming.zh: 牧童遠遠地指向杏花村。
qingming.en: A herd-boy points far off to Apricot Blossom Village.
qingming.simp: 牧童远远地指向杏花村。

hanshi.src: 春城無處不飛花，寒食東風御柳斜。
hanshi.zh: 春天的長安城，沒有一處不飛著花，寒食節的東風吹斜了御苑的柳枝。
hanshi.en: In the spring city there is no place without drifting blossom; on Cold Food Day the east wind slants the willows of the royal garden.
hanshi.simp: 春天的长安城，没有一处不飞着花，寒食节的东风吹斜了御苑的柳枝。

hanshi.src: 日暮漢宮傳蠟燭，輕煙散入五侯家。
hanshi.zh: 日暮時分，漢宮傳賜蠟燭，輕煙飄散，進入五位侯爵的家中。
hanshi.en: At dusk candles are passed out from the Han palace, and thin smoke drifts into the houses of the five marquises.
hanshi.simp: 日暮时分，汉宫传赐蜡烛，轻烟飘散，进入五位侯爵的家中。

haitang.src: 東風嫋嫋泛崇光，香霧空濛月轉廊。
haitang.zh: 東風輕柔地吹拂，浮動著明亮的春光，香霧朦朧，月亮轉過迴廊。
haitang.en: The east wind blows gently and floats the bright light; fragrant mist is dim and hazy, and the moon turns past the corridor.
haitang.simp: 东风轻柔地吹拂，浮动着明亮的春光，香雾朦胧，月亮转过回廊。

haitang.src: 只恐夜深花睡去，故燒高燭照紅粧。
haitang.zh: 只怕夜深了花兒睡去，所以點燃高高的蠟燭，照著她紅色的妝容。
haitang.en: I only fear that in the deep night the flowers will sleep, so I light tall candles to shine on her red make-up.
haitang.simp: 只怕夜深了花儿睡去，所以点燃高高的蜡烛，照着她红色的妆容。

sheri.src: 鵝湖山下稻粱肥，豚柵雞棲半掩扉。
sheri.zh: 鵝湖山下稻子和高粱長得肥壯，豬圈和雞窩的門半掩著。
sheri.en: Below Goose Lake Hill the rice and millet are fat; the pigpens and hen-roosts have half-closed doors.
sheri.simp: 鹅湖山下稻子和高粱长得肥壮，猪圈和鸡窝的门半掩着。

sheri.src: 桑柘影斜春社散，家家扶得醉人歸。
sheri.zh: 桑樹柘樹的影子傾斜，春社的聚會散了，家家扶著喝醉的人回家。
sheri.en: The shadows of mulberry and cudrania slant; the spring festival ends, and each household helps home its drunken man.
sheri.simp: 桑树柘树的影子倾斜，春社的聚会散了，家家扶着喝醉的人回家。

huaying.src: 重重疊疊上瑤臺，幾度呼童掃不開。
huaying.zh: 花影一層層疊疊地爬上了瑤臺，幾次叫童子來掃，卻怎麼也掃不開。
huaying.en: Layer on layer, the flower shadows climb the jade terrace; I call the boy to sweep, again and again, but they will not clear.
huaying.simp: 花影一层层叠叠地爬上了瑶台，几次叫童子来扫，却怎么也扫不开。

huaying.src: 剛被太陽收拾去，卻教明月送將來。
huaying.zh: 剛剛被太陽收走，卻又讓明月把它送回來。
huaying.en: Just as the sun takes them away, the bright moon brings them back.
huaying.simp: 刚刚被太阳收走，却又让明月把它送回来。

beishan.src: 北山輸綠漲橫池，直塹回塘灩灩時。
beishan.zh: 北山把一片翠綠送進池塘，使池水漲滿，直直的水渠和彎曲的池塘都波光盪漾。
beishan.en: North Hill pours its green into the pond, which brims; the straight ditch and winding pool shimmer.
beishan.simp: 北山把一片翠绿送进池塘，使池水涨满，直直的水渠和弯曲的池塘都波光荡漾。

beishan.src: 細數落花因坐久，緩尋芳草得歸遲。
beishan.zh: 因為坐得久，我一朵一朵地細數落花；慢慢尋找芳草，回來得晚了。
beishan.en: Having sat long, I count the fallen petals one by one; slowly seeking fragrant grass, I come home late.
beishan.simp: 因为坐得久，我一朵一朵地细数落花；慢慢寻找芳草，回来得晚了。

hushang.src: 花開紅樹亂鶯啼，草長平湖白鷺飛。
hushang.zh: 紅花盛開的樹上黃鶯亂啼，草長滿平靜的湖岸，白鷺飛翔。
hushang.en: Flowers open on the red trees and orioles sing wildly; grass grows along the calm lake and egrets fly.
hushang.simp: 红花盛开的树上黄莺乱啼，草长满平静的湖岸，白鹭飞翔。

hushang.src: 風日平和人意好，夕陽簫鼓幾船歸。
hushang.zh: 風和日麗，人的心情也好；夕陽下簫聲鼓聲，有幾條船載人歸來。
hushang.en: Wind and sun are gentle and people's moods are fine; in the evening, to flutes and drums, several boats come home.
hushang.simp: 风和日丽，人的心情也好；夕阳下箫声鼓声，有几条船载人归来。

chunqing.src: 雨來未見花間蕊，雨後全無葉底花。
chunqing.zh: 雨來時看不見花間的花蕊，雨後葉子底下全都沒有花了。
chunqing.en: When the rain came I saw no buds among the flowers; after the rain no blossoms remain under the leaves.
chunqing.simp: 雨来时看不见花间的花蕊，雨后叶子底下全都没有花了。

chunqing.src: 蜂蝶紛紛過牆去，卻疑春色在鄰家。
chunqing.zh: 蜜蜂蝴蝶紛紛飛過牆去，我才懷疑春色是在鄰家了。
chunqing.en: Bees and butterflies fly over the wall in crowds, and I suspect the spring must be at my neighbour's.
chunqing.simp: 蜜蜂蝴蝶纷纷飞过墙去，我才怀疑春色是在邻家了。

chunmu.src: 門外無人問落花，綠陰冉冉遍天涯。
chunmu.zh: 門外沒有人來問落花的事，綠蔭漸漸蔓延到天邊。
chunmu.en: Outside the gate no one asks after the fallen flowers; green shade slowly spreads to the edge of the sky.
chunmu.simp: 门外没有人来问落花的事，绿荫渐渐蔓延到天边。

chunmu.src: 林鶯啼到無聲處，青草池塘獨聽蛙。
chunmu.zh: 林中的黃鶯啼到沒有了聲音，只剩在長滿青草的池塘邊獨自聽蛙鳴。
chunmu.en: Until the orioles in the wood sing themselves silent; I alone listen to frogs by the grassy pond.
chunmu.simp: 林中的黄莺啼到没有了声音，只剩在长满青草的池塘边独自听蛙鸣。

chunmuyouxiaoyuan.src: 一從梅粉褪殘粧，塗抹新紅上海棠。
chunmuyouxiaoyuan.zh: 自從梅花脫去了殘敗的妝飾，新的紅色就塗抹在海棠上。
chunmuyouxiaoyuan.en: Ever since the plum shed its worn make-up, fresh red has been painted on the crabapple.
chunmuyouxiaoyuan.simp: 自从梅花脱去了残败的妆饰，新的红色就涂抹在海棠上。

chunmuyouxiaoyuan.src: 開到荼蘼花事了，絲絲天棘出莓牆。
chunmuyouxiaoyuan.zh: 荼蘼開過，花事就結束了，細細的天棘從長滿青苔的牆上伸出來。
chunmuyouxiaoyuan.en: When the tumi has bloomed, the season of flowers is over; slender thorny vines come out over the mossy wall.
chunmuyouxiaoyuan.simp: 荼蘼开过，花事就结束了，细细的天棘从长满青苔的墙上伸出来。

dengshan.src: 終日昏昏醉夢間，忽聞春盡強登山。
dengshan.zh: 整天昏昏沉沉，像在醉夢之中，忽然聽說春天將盡，便勉強去登山。
dengshan.en: All day I was dazed as if in a drunken dream; suddenly hearing that spring was ending, I forced myself to climb a hill.
dengshan.simp: 整天昏昏沉沉，像在醉梦之中，忽然听说春天将尽，便勉强去登山。

dengshan.src: 因過竹院逢僧話，又得浮生半日閒。
dengshan.zh: 路過竹林院落，遇見僧人交談，又得到浮生中的半天閒暇。
dengshan.en: Passing a bamboo courtyard I met a monk and talked, and so gained half a day of leisure from this floating life.
dengshan.simp: 路过竹林院落，遇见僧人交谈，又得到浮生中的半天闲暇。

wanchun.src: 誰收春色將歸去，慢綠妖紅半不存。
wanchun.zh: 是誰收走春色要把它帶回去，嫩綠和豔紅已不剩一半了。
wanchun.en: Who is gathering up the colours of spring to carry them off? Half the soft green and bright red is gone.
wanchun.simp: 是谁收走春色要把它带回去，嫩绿和艳红已不剩一半了。

wanchun.src: 榆莢只能隨柳絮，等閑撩亂走空園。
wanchun.zh: 榆莢只能跟著柳絮飛舞，隨隨便便地亂飛過空蕩的園子。
wanchun.en: The elm pods can only follow the willow fluff, drifting aimlessly through the empty garden.
wanchun.simp: 榆荚只能跟着柳絮飞舞，随随便便地乱飞过空荡的园子。

sanyuehuirisongchun.src: 三月正當三十日，春風別我苦吟身。
sanyuehuirisongchun.zh: 三月正好是三十日，春風要和我這苦吟的人告別。
sanyuehuirisongchun.en: The third month has come to its thirtieth day, and the spring wind takes leave of me, a man who chants his verses in pain.
sanyuehuirisongchun.simp: 三月正好是三十日，春风要和我这苦吟的人告别。

sanyuehuirisongchun.src: 共君今夜不須睡，未過曉鐘猶是春。
sanyuehuirisongchun.zh: 今夜我和你都不必睡覺，只要沒聽到天亮的鐘聲，就還算是春天。
sanyuehuirisongchun.en: Tonight you and I need not sleep; until the dawn bell sounds, it is still spring.
sanyuehuirisongchun.simp: 今夜我和你都不必睡觉，只要没听到天亮的钟声，就还算是春天。

youyue.src: 黃梅時節家家雨，青草池塘處處蛙。
youyue.zh: 黃梅時節家家都下著雨，長滿青草的池塘到處是蛙聲。
youyue.en: In the plum-rain season it rains on every house; by the grassy ponds there are frogs everywhere.
youyue.simp: 黄梅时节家家都下着雨，长满青草的池塘到处是蛙声。

youyue.src: 有約不來過夜半，閒敲棋子落燈花。
youyue.zh: 約好的客人過了半夜還不來，我閒著用手敲棋子，震落了燈花。
youyue.en: The guest we agreed on does not come past midnight; I idly tap a chess piece, and the lamp wick drops its sparks.
youyue.simp: 约好的客人过了半夜还不来，我闲着用手敲棋子，震落了灯花。

chuxiashuiqi.src: 梅子流酸濺齒牙，芭蕉分綠上窗紗。
chuxiashuiqi.zh: 梅子酸得讓人牙齒發軟，芭蕉的綠色映上窗紗。
chuxiashuiqi.en: The plums are so sour they set the teeth on edge; the green of the plantain spreads over the window gauze.
chuxiashuiqi.simp: 梅子酸得让人牙齿发软，芭蕉的绿色映上窗纱。

chuxiashuiqi.src: 日長睡起無情思，閑看兒童捉柳花。
chuxiashuiqi.zh: 夏日漫長，睡醒後沒有什麼心思，閒閒地看孩子們捉柳絮。
chuxiashuiqi.en: The summer day is long, and on waking I have no particular thought; I idly watch the children catch willow fluff.
chuxiashuiqi.simp: 夏日漫长，睡醒后没有什么心思，闲闲地看孩子们捉柳絮。

sanqudaozhong.src: 梅子黃時日日晴，小溪汛盡卻山行。
sanqudaozhong.zh: 梅子黃熟的時候天天晴朗，小溪的水漲過了，我又改走山路。
sanqudaozhong.en: When the plums turn yellow, every day is fine; the stream's floods are over, so I take the hill road.
sanqudaozhong.simp: 梅子黄熟的时候天天晴朗，小溪的水涨过了，我又改走山路。

sanqudaozhong.src: 綠陰不減來時路，添得黃鸝四五聲。
sanqudaozhong.zh: 路上的綠蔭不比來時少，還多了四五聲黃鸝的啼叫。
sanqudaozhong.en: The green shade on the road is no less than when I came, and there are four or five more calls of orioles.
sanqudaozhong.simp: 路上的绿荫不比来时少，还多了四五声黄鹂的啼叫。

shantingxiari.src: 綠樹陰濃夏日長，樓臺倒影入池塘。
shantingxiari.zh: 綠樹濃蔭，夏天白晝漫長，樓臺的倒影映入池塘。
shantingxiari.en: Green trees give thick shade and the summer day is long; the reflection of the pavilion falls into the pond.
shantingxiari.simp: 绿树浓荫，夏天白昼漫长，楼台的倒影映入池塘。

shantingxiari.src: 水晶簾動微風起，滿架薔薇一院香。
shantingxiari.zh: 水晶簾子晃動，微風吹起，滿架的薔薇使整個院子都是香氣。
shantingxiari.en: The crystal curtain moves, a light breeze rises, and roses on the whole trellis scent the entire courtyard.
shantingxiari.simp: 水晶帘子晃动，微风吹起，满架的蔷薇使整个院子都是香气。

tianjia.src: 晝出耘田夜績麻，村莊兒女各當家。
tianjia.zh: 白天出去耕田除草，夜裡紡績麻線，村莊裡的男女各自操持家務。
tianjia.en: By day they go out to weed the fields, by night they spin hemp; the men and women of the village each run their own household.
tianjia.simp: 白天出去耕田除草，夜里纺绩麻线，村庄里的男女各自操持家务。

tianjia.src: 童孫未解供耕織，也傍桑陰學種瓜。
tianjia.zh: 孩子們還不懂得耕種紡織，也在桑樹蔭下學著種瓜。
tianjia.en: The small grandchildren do not yet know ploughing or weaving, but under the mulberry shade they learn to plant melons.
tianjia.simp: 孩子们还不懂得耕种纺织，也在桑树荫下学着种瓜。

xiangcunsiyue.src: 綠遍山原白滿川，子規聲裡雨如煙。
xiangcunsiyue.zh: 山野原上一片綠，河川水光一片白，杜鵑聲中細雨如煙。
xiangcunsiyue.en: Green over hills and plains, white over the streams; in the cuckoo's call the rain is like mist.
xiangcunsiyue.simp: 山野原上一片绿，河川水光一片白，杜鹃声中细雨如烟。

xiangcunsiyue.src: 鄉村四月閒人少，纔了蠶桑又插田。
xiangcunsiyue.zh: 鄉村的四月沒有幾個閒人，剛忙完養蠶採桑，又要插秧。
xiangcunsiyue.en: In the fourth month the village has few idle people: no sooner done with silkworms and mulberry than it is time to plant rice.
xiangcunsiyue.simp: 乡村的四月没有几个闲人，刚忙完养蚕采桑，又要插秧。

cunwan.src: 草滿池塘水滿陂，山銜落日浸寒漪。
cunwan.zh: 草長滿池塘，水漲滿堤塘，山銜著落日，在寒冷的水波上浸著倒影。
cunwan.en: Grass fills the pond and water fills the bank; the hill holds the setting sun, which soaks in the cold ripples.
cunwan.simp: 草长满池塘，水涨满堤塘，山衔着落日，在寒冷的水波上浸着倒影。

cunwan.src: 牧童歸去橫牛背，短笛無腔信口吹。
cunwan.zh: 牧童回家，橫坐在牛背上，隨口吹著不成調的短笛。
cunwan.en: The herd-boy rides home sideways on the ox's back, blowing a short flute as he likes, with no tune.
cunwan.simp: 牧童回家，横坐在牛背上，随口吹着不成调的短笛。

shuhuyinxianshengbi.src: 茅檐長掃淨無苔，花木成畦手自栽。
shuhuyinxianshengbi.zh: 茅屋簷下常常打掃，乾淨得沒有青苔，花木一畦一畦的，都是親手栽種。
shuhuyinxianshengbi.en: The thatched eaves are swept so often there is no moss; flowers and trees stand in beds, all planted by hand.
shuhuyinxianshengbi.simp: 茅屋檐下常常打扫，干净得没有青苔，花木一畦一畦的，都是亲手栽种。

shuhuyinxianshengbi.src: 一水護田將綠繞，兩山排闥送青來。
shuhuyinxianshengbi.zh: 一道溪水護著田地，帶著綠意環繞；兩座青山推開門戶，送來一片青翠。
shuhuyinxianshengbi.en: One stream guards the fields and winds around them in green; two hills push open the doors and send in their blue.
shuhuyinxianshengbi.simp: 一道溪水护着田地，带着绿意环绕；两座青山推开门户，送来一片青翠。

yushilangzhongqintinghuangheloushangchui.src: 一為遷客去長沙，西望長安不見家。
yushilangzhongqintinghuangheloushangchui.zh: 我一旦成了被貶的遷客，離開長安去長沙，向西望長安，看不到家。
yushilangzhongqintinghuangheloushangchui.en: Once I became an exile sent to Changsha, and looking west towards Chang'an I cannot see home.
yushilangzhongqintinghuangheloushangchui.simp: 我一旦成了被贬的迁客，离开长安去长沙，向西望长安，看不到家。

yushilangzhongqintinghuangheloushangchui.src: 黃鶴樓中吹玉笛，江城五月落梅花。
yushilangzhongqintinghuangheloushangchui.zh: 黃鶴樓中吹起玉笛，江城五月裡，彷彿有梅花飄落。
yushilangzhongqintinghuangheloushangchui.en: In Yellow Crane Tower a jade flute is played; in the river city, in the fifth month, plum blossoms seem to fall.
yushilangzhongqintinghuangheloushangchui.simp: 黄鹤楼中吹起玉笛，江城五月里，仿佛有梅花飘落。

qixi.src: 銀燭秋光冷畫屏，輕羅小扇撲流螢。
qixi.zh: 秋夜銀白的蠟燭，光冷冷地照在畫屏上，我用輕羅小扇撲打流動的螢火蟲。
qixi.en: Silver candles in the autumn night shed a cold light on the painted screen; with a small silk fan I swat at drifting fireflies.
qixi.simp: 秋夜银白的蜡烛，光冷冷地照在画屏上，我用轻罗小扇扑打流动的萤火虫。

qixi.src: 天階夜色涼如水，臥看牽牛織女星。
qixi.zh: 石階上的夜色涼得像水，躺著望牽牛星和織女星。
qixi.en: The night on the palace steps is cool as water; lying back, I watch the Herd Boy and Weaver Girl stars.
qixi.simp: 石阶上的夜色凉得像水，躺着望牵牛星和织女星。

liqiu.src: 乳鴉啼散玉屏空，一枕新涼一扇風。
liqiu.zh: 小烏鴉啼叫著飛散，玉屏風旁空了，枕上一絲新涼，一把扇子送來清風。
liqiu.en: Young crows have cried and scattered, the jade screen is empty; a pillow of new coolness, a fan that stirs the breeze.
liqiu.simp: 小乌鸦啼叫着飞散，玉屏风旁空了，枕上一丝新凉，一把扇子送来清风。

liqiu.src: 睡起秋聲無覓處，滿階梧葉月明中。
liqiu.zh: 睡醒後聽不到秋聲在哪裡，滿階的梧桐葉在明亮的月光中。
liqiu.en: Waking, I cannot find where the sound of autumn is; the steps are covered with parasol leaves in bright moonlight.
liqiu.simp: 睡醒后听不到秋声在哪里，满阶的梧桐叶在明亮的月光中。

zhongqiuyue.src: 暮雲收盡溢清寒，銀漢無聲轉玉盤。
zhongqiuyue.zh: 傍晚的雲收盡了，滿溢著清寒的氣息，銀河無聲，月亮像玉盤般轉動。
zhongqiuyue.en: The evening clouds are gone and a clear coolness overflows; the Milky Way is silent, and the moon turns like a jade plate.
zhongqiuyue.simp: 傍晚的云收尽了，满溢着清寒的气息，银河无声，月亮像玉盘般转动。

zhongqiuyue.src: 此生此夜不長好，明月明年何處看。
zhongqiuyue.zh: 這一生裡這樣的夜晚不會長久美好，明年的明月又將在哪裡看呢？
zhongqiuyue.en: Such a night in this life will not last; where shall I see the bright moon next year?
zhongqiuyue.simp: 这一生里这样的夜晚不会长久美好，明年的明月又将在哪里看呢？

jianglouyougan.src: 獨上江樓思悄然，月光如水水如天。
jianglouyougan.zh: 獨自登上江樓，心中靜靜地思念，月光像水一樣，水又像天一樣。
jianglouyougan.en: Alone I climb the river tower, thinking in silence; the moonlight is like water, and the water is like the sky.
jianglouyougan.simp: 独自登上江楼，心中静静地思念，月光像水一样，水又像天一样。

jianglouyougan.src: 同來玩月人何在，風景依稀似去年。
jianglouyougan.zh: 當初一起來賞月的人在哪裡？風景依稀像去年一樣。
jianglouyougan.en: Where are those who came with me to enjoy the moon? The scene is almost the same as last year.
jianglouyougan.simp: 当初一起来赏月的人在哪里？风景依稀像去年一样。

tilinandi.src: 山外青山樓外樓，西湖歌舞幾時休？
tilinandi.zh: 青山之外還有青山，樓閣之外還有樓閣，西湖的歌舞何時才會停止？
tilinandi.en: Beyond green hills, more green hills; beyond towers, more towers. When will the singing and dancing at West Lake stop?
tilinandi.simp: 青山之外还有青山，楼阁之外还有楼阁，西湖的歌舞何时才会停止？

tilinandi.src: 暖風熏得遊人醉，直把杭州作汴州。
tilinandi.zh: 暖風吹得遊人如醉，竟把杭州當成了汴州。
tilinandi.en: The warm wind makes the pleasure-seekers drunk; they take Hangzhou for Bianzhou, the old capital.
tilinandi.simp: 暖风吹得游人如醉，竟把杭州当成了汴州。

xiaochujingcisisonglinzifang.src: 畢竟西湖六月中，風光不與四時同。
xiaochujingcisisonglinzifang.zh: 畢竟是西湖六月中的景色，風光與其他季節都不一樣。
xiaochujingcisisonglinzifang.en: After all, this is West Lake in the sixth month; the scenery is unlike any other season.
xiaochujingcisisonglinzifang.simp: 毕竟是西湖六月中的景色，风光与其他季节都不一样。

xiaochujingcisisonglinzifang.src: 接天蓮葉無窮碧，映日荷花別樣紅。
xiaochujingcisisonglinzifang.zh: 連著天邊的蓮葉無邊無際地碧綠，映著陽光的荷花格外鮮紅。
xiaochujingcisisonglinzifang.en: Lotus leaves joined to the sky are endlessly green; lotus flowers in the sun are an unusual red.
xiaochujingcisisonglinzifang.simp: 连着天边的莲叶无边无际地碧绿，映着阳光的荷花格外鲜红。

zengliujingwen.src: 荷盡已無擎雨蓋，菊殘猶有傲霜枝。
zengliujingwen.zh: 荷花敗盡，已經沒有擎著雨的荷葉；菊花雖殘，卻還有傲霜的枝條。
zengliujingwen.en: The lotus is gone, with no more leaves to hold the rain; the chrysanthemum is withered, but its stems still stand proud of the frost.
zengliujingwen.simp: 荷花败尽，已经没有擎着雨的荷叶；菊花虽残，却还有傲霜的枝条。

zengliujingwen.src: 一年好景君須記，最是橙黃橘綠時。
zengliujingwen.zh: 一年的好景你一定要記住，最美的就是橙子黃、橘子綠的時節。
zengliujingwen.en: You must remember the best of the year: it is the time when oranges are yellow and tangerines still green.
zengliujingwen.simp: 一年的好景你一定要记住，最美的就是橙子黄、橘子绿的时节。

hanye.src: 寒夜客來茶當酒，竹爐湯沸火初紅。
hanye.zh: 寒冷的夜裡客人來了，以茶代酒，竹爐裡的水燒開了，爐火剛剛燒紅。
hanye.en: On a cold night a guest comes, and tea stands for wine; the water boils in the bamboo stove and the fire has just turned red.
hanye.simp: 寒冷的夜里客人来了，以茶代酒，竹炉里的水烧开了，炉火刚刚烧红。

hanye.src: 尋常一樣窗前月，才有梅花便不同。
hanye.zh: 尋常一樣的窗前月光，只要有了梅花，就不一樣了。
hanye.en: The moon at the window is the same as always, but once there are plum blossoms, it is different.
hanye.simp: 寻常一样的窗前月光，只要有了梅花，就不一样了。

xuemei.src: 梅雪爭春未肯降，騷人擱筆費評章。
xuemei.zh: 梅花和雪爭奪春色，誰都不肯認輸，詩人們為難以評判而擱下了筆。
xuemei.en: Plum and snow vie for spring and neither will yield; poets put down their brushes, finding it hard to judge.
xuemei.simp: 梅花和雪争夺春色，谁都不肯认输，诗人们为难以评判而搁下了笔。

xuemei.src: 梅須遜雪三分白，雪卻輸梅一段香。
xuemei.zh: 梅花要遜讓雪三分潔白，雪卻輸給梅花一段清香。
xuemei.en: The plum must give way to snow by three parts of whiteness; the snow loses to the plum by a measure of fragrance.
xuemei.simp: 梅花要逊让雪三分洁白，雪却输给梅花一段清香。

xuemei.src: 有梅無雪不精神，有雪無詩俗了人。
xuemei.zh: 有梅花而沒有雪就不精神，有雪而沒有詩就俗氣了。
xuemei.en: Plum without snow lacks spirit; snow without poetry makes one vulgar.
xuemei.simp: 有梅花而没有雪就不精神，有雪而没有诗就俗气了。

xuemei.src: 日暮詩成天又雪，與梅並作十分春。
xuemei.zh: 日暮時詩寫成了，天又下起雪，與梅花一起構成十分的春意。
xuemei.en: At dusk the poem is done and the sky snows again; with the plum it makes spring complete.
xuemei.simp: 日暮时诗写成了，天又下起雪，与梅花一起构成十分的春意。

guiyan.src: 瀟湘何事等閑回，水碧沙明兩岸苔。
guiyan.zh: 瀟湘一帶為什麼事讓你輕易回來？那裡水碧沙明，兩岸長滿青苔。
guiyan.en: Why do you so lightly leave Xiao and Xiang, where the water is green, the sand bright, and both banks are mossy?
guiyan.simp: 潇湘一带为什么事让你轻易回来？那里水碧沙明，两岸长满青苔。

guiyan.src: 二十五弦彈夜月，不勝清怨卻飛來。
guiyan.zh: 因為二十五弦的瑟在夜月下彈奏，清怨之情令人無法承受，你們便飛了回來。
guiyan.en: Because the twenty-five-string zither plays under the night moon, and its pure grief is too much to bear, you fly back.
guiyan.simp: 因为二十五弦的瑟在夜月下弹奏，清怨之情令人无法承受，你们便飞了回来。

jiangcun.src: 清江一曲抱村流，長夏江村事事幽。
jiangcun.zh: 清澈的江水彎彎一曲環抱著村莊流過，漫長的夏天裡江村事事幽靜。
jiangcun.en: The clear river makes one bend and flows round the village; in the long summer, everything in the river village is quiet.
jiangcun.simp: 清澈的江水弯弯一曲环抱着村庄流过，漫长的夏天里江村事事幽静。

jiangcun.src: 自去自來堂上燕，相親相近水中鷗。
jiangcun.zh: 堂上的燕子自去自來，水中的白鷗相親相近。
jiangcun.en: The swallows in the hall come and go on their own; the gulls on the water keep close and friendly.
jiangcun.simp: 堂上的燕子自去自来，水中的白鸥相亲相近。

jiangcun.src: 老妻畫紙為棋局，稚子敲針作釣鉤。
jiangcun.zh: 老妻在紙上畫棋盤，幼子敲彎縫衣針做成釣鉤。
jiangcun.en: My old wife draws a chessboard on paper, and my small son bends a needle into a fishhook.
jiangcun.simp: 老妻在纸上画棋盘，幼子敲弯缝衣针做成钓钩。

jiangcun.src: 多病所須唯藥物，微軀此外更何求。
jiangcun.zh: 多病的我所需要的只有藥物，微小的身體除此之外還求什麼呢？
jiangcun.en: All a sickly man needs is medicine; what else can this small body ask for?
jiangcun.simp: 多病的我所需要的只有药物，微小的身体除此之外还求什么呢？

xiaozhi.src: 天時人事日相催，冬至陽生春又來。
xiaozhi.zh: 天時和人事天天互相催促，冬至一到陽氣初生，春天又要來了。
xiaozhi.en: Heaven's seasons and human affairs press each other day by day; at the winter solstice yang is born and spring is coming again.
xiaozhi.simp: 天时和人事天天互相催促，冬至一到阳气初生，春天又要来了。

xiaozhi.src: 刺繡五紋添弱線，吹葭六琯動浮灰。
xiaozhi.zh: 刺繡的女工因白天變長，多繡了五種花紋的細線；吹動葭灰的六根律管，使浮灰飛動。
xiaozhi.en: The embroiderers add a little thread to their five-colour patterns as the days lengthen; the six pitch-pipes stir their ash of reed.
xiaozhi.simp: 刺绣的女工因白天变长，多绣了五种花纹的细线；吹动葭灰的六根律管，使浮灰飞动。

xiaozhi.src: 岸容待臘將舒柳，山意衝寒欲放梅。
xiaozhi.zh: 河岸的景象等待臘月將要舒展柳條，山中的氣息衝破寒冷，快要開出梅花。
xiaozhi.en: The banks wait for the twelfth month to loosen the willows; the mountain's spirit pushes through the cold, ready to open the plum.
xiaozhi.simp: 河岸的景象等待腊月将要舒展柳条，山中的气息冲破寒冷，快要开出梅花。

xiaozhi.src: 雲物不殊鄉國異，教兒且覆掌中杯。
xiaozhi.zh: 這裡的雲物與故鄉沒有不同，只是身在異鄉，且讓孩子把手中杯裡的酒喝盡吧。
xiaozhi.en: The clouds and scenery here are no different from home, though the land is foreign; let my son drain the cup in his hand.
xiaozhi.simp: 这里的云物与故乡没有不同，只是身在异乡，且让孩子把手中杯里的酒喝尽吧。

zuoqianzhilanguanshizhisunxiang.src: 一封朝奏九重天，夕貶潮州路八千。
zuoqianzhilanguanshizhisunxiang.zh: 早晨我把一封奏書呈給九重天上的皇帝，傍晚就被貶謫到八千里外的潮州。
zuoqianzhilanguanshizhisunxiang.en: In the morning I sent a memorial up to the Emperor in the ninth heaven; by evening I was demoted, eight thousand li to Chaozhou.
zuoqianzhilanguanshizhisunxiang.simp: 早晨我把一封奏书呈给九重天上的皇帝，傍晚就被贬谪到八千里外的潮州。

zuoqianzhilanguanshizhisunxiang.src: 欲為聖明除弊事，肯將衰朽惜殘年？
zuoqianzhilanguanshizhisunxiang.zh: 想為聖明的朝廷除掉弊政，怎麼肯為衰老的殘年而吝惜自己？
zuoqianzhilanguanshizhisunxiang.en: I wished to remove abuses for a wise court; how could I spare myself for the sake of my declining years?
zuoqianzhilanguanshizhisunxiang.simp: 想为圣明的朝廷除掉弊政，怎么肯为衰老的残年而吝惜自己？

zuoqianzhilanguanshizhisunxiang.zh: 雲橫在秦嶺上，我的家在哪裡？
zuoqianzhilanguanshizhisunxiang.en: Clouds lie across the Qinling; where is my home?
zuoqianzhilanguanshizhisunxiang.simp: 云横在秦岭上，我的家在哪里？

zuoqianzhilanguanshizhisunxiang.zh: 大雪擁住藍關，馬也不肯前進。
zuoqianzhilanguanshizhisunxiang.en: Snow blocks Languan Pass, and the horse will not go on.
zuoqianzhilanguanshizhisunxiang.simp: 大雪拥住蓝关，马也不肯前进。

zuoqianzhilanguanshizhisunxiang.src: 知汝遠來應有意，好收吾骨瘴江邊。
zuoqianzhilanguanshizhisunxiang.zh: 我知道你遠道而來必有用意，好在瘴氣瀰漫的江邊收殮我的屍骨。
zuoqianzhilanguanshizhisunxiang.en: I know you come so far with a purpose: to gather my bones beside the river of miasma.
zuoqianzhilanguanshizhisunxiang.simp: 我知道你远道而来必有用意，好在瘴气弥漫的江边收殓我的尸骨。

jiurilantiancuishizhuang.src: 老去悲秋強自寬，興來今日盡君歡。
jiurilantiancuishizhuang.zh: 人老了，對秋天感到悲傷，只能勉強自我寬慰；今天興致來了，就盡情陪你歡樂。
jiurilantiancuishizhuang.en: Old, I grieve at autumn and can only comfort myself with effort; today the mood has come, and I enjoy myself fully with you.
jiurilantiancuishizhuang.simp: 人老了，对秋天感到悲伤，只能勉强自我宽慰；今天兴致来了，就尽情陪你欢乐。

jiurilantiancuishizhuang.src: 羞將短髮還吹帽，笑倩旁人為正冠。
jiurilantiancuishizhuang.zh: 怕自己稀疏的短髮被風吹掉帽子，笑著請旁人幫忙把帽子扶正。
jiurilantiancuishizhuang.en: Ashamed that the wind will blow off my cap from my thin hair, I laughingly ask the one beside me to set it straight.
jiurilantiancuishizhuang.simp: 怕自己稀疏的短发被风吹掉帽子，笑着请旁人帮忙把帽子扶正。

jiurilantiancuishizhuang.src: 藍水遠從千澗落，玉山高並兩峰寒。
jiurilantiancuishizhuang.zh: 藍水從遠處千條山澗中落下，玉山高高地並列著兩座寒峰。
jiurilantiancuishizhuang.en: The Lan River falls from far, from a thousand gullies; Jade Mountain rises with two cold peaks side by side.
jiurilantiancuishizhuang.simp: 蓝水从远处千条山涧中落下，玉山高高地并列着两座寒峰。

jiurilantiancuishizhuang.src: 明年此會知誰健，醉把茱萸子細看。
jiurilantiancuishizhuang.zh: 明年這樣的聚會不知誰還健在，我醉意中拿起茱萸，仔細看著。
jiurilantiancuishizhuang.en: Who will be well at this gathering next year? Drunk, I take up the dogwood sprig and look at it closely.
jiurilantiancuishizhuang.simp: 明年这样的聚会不知谁还健在，我醉意中拿起茱萸，仔细看着。

qiusi.src: 利欲驅人萬火牛，江湖浪跡一沙鷗。
qiusi.zh: 利欲驅使人們像成千上萬放火的牛，我卻像江湖上漂泊的一隻沙鷗。
qiusi.en: Greed for profit drives people like ten thousand oxen with fire on their tails; I drift on rivers and lakes like a single sand gull.
qiusi.simp: 利欲驱使人们像成千上万放火的牛，我却像江湖上漂泊的一只沙鸥。

qiusi.src: 日長似歲閒方覺，事大如天醉亦休。
qiusi.zh: 空閒時才覺得白天長得像一年，事情大如天，一醉也就算了。
qiusi.en: Only in idleness do I feel a day as long as a year; matters as big as heaven are done with once I am drunk.
qiusi.simp: 空闲时才觉得白天长得像一年，事情大如天，一醉也就算了。

qiusi.src: 砧杵敲殘深巷月，梧桐搖落故園秋。
qiusi.zh: 深巷的月夜裡傳來搗衣聲逐漸停息，故鄉園中的梧桐正搖落秋葉。
qiusi.en: In the deep lane under the moon, the sound of the washing-mallets dies away; at my old home the parasol trees are shedding their autumn leaves.
qiusi.simp: 深巷的月夜里传来捣衣声逐渐停息，故乡园中的梧桐正摇落秋叶。

qiusi.src: 欲舒老眼無高處，安得元龍百尺樓。
qiusi.zh: 想舒展老眼，卻無高處可登，怎能得到像陳元龍那樣的百尺高樓？
qiusi.en: I want to open my old eyes wide, but there is no high place; how could I have a hundred-foot tower like Chen Yuanlong's?
qiusi.simp: 想舒展老眼，却无高处可登，怎能得到像陈元龙那样的百尺高楼？

zhanganqiuwang.src: 雲物淒涼拂曙流，漢家宮闕動高秋。
zhanganqiuwang.zh: 雲和景物淒涼，在拂曉時流動，漢朝的宮闕在深秋中顯得高聳震動。
zhanganqiuwang.en: Clouds and scenery look bleak and drift at daybreak; the palace towers of the Han loom and tremble in the deep autumn.
zhanganqiuwang.simp: 云和景物凄凉，在拂晓时流动，汉朝的宫阙在深秋中显得高耸震动。

zhanganqiuwang.src: 殘星幾點雁橫塞，長笛一聲人倚樓。
zhanganqiuwang.zh: 天上還有幾點殘星，大雁橫過邊塞，一聲長笛，有人倚著高樓。
zhanganqiuwang.en: A few last stars remain and wild geese cross the frontier; one long flute note, and someone leans on the tower.
zhanganqiuwang.simp: 天上还有几点残星，大雁横过边塞，一声长笛，有人倚着高楼。

zhanganqiuwang.src: 紫豔半開籬菊靜，紅衣落盡渚蓮愁。
zhanganqiuwang.zh: 紫色的菊花半開，籬邊靜靜的；紅衣般的荷花落盡，水邊的蓮花滿是愁。
zhanganqiuwang.en: Purple chrysanthemums half-open, quiet by the hedge; the red-robed lotus petals have all fallen, and the lotus on the shore looks sad.
zhanganqiuwang.simp: 紫色的菊花半开，篱边静静的；红衣般的荷花落尽，水边的莲花满是愁。

zhanganqiuwang.src: 鱸魚正美不歸去，空戴南冠學楚囚。
zhanganqiuwang.zh: 鱸魚正是鮮美的時節卻不回鄉，白白戴著南冠，學那楚囚。
zhanganqiuwang.en: Perch are at their best, yet I do not go home; I wear the southern cap for nothing, like the prisoner of Chu.
zhanganqiuwang.simp: 鲈鱼正是鲜美的时节却不回乡，白白戴着南冠，学那楚囚。

dalidan.src: 去年花裏逢君別，今日花開又一年。
dalidan.zh: 去年在花叢中與你相逢又分別，今天花又開了，已是一年。
dalidan.en: Last year among the flowers I met you and parted; now the flowers bloom again, and a year has passed.
dalidan.simp: 去年在花丛中与你相逢又分别，今天花又开了，已是一年。

dalidan.src: 世事茫茫難自料，春愁黯黯獨成眠。
dalidan.zh: 世事茫茫，難以自己預料，春愁暗沉，我獨自入睡。
dalidan.en: The affairs of the world are vast and unclear, hard to foresee; in dim spring sorrow, I go to sleep alone.
dalidan.simp: 世事茫茫，难以自己预料，春愁暗沉，我独自入睡。

dalidan.src: 身多疾病思田里，邑有流亡愧俸錢。
dalidan.zh: 我身多疾病，思念田園鄉里，所治的縣邑有流亡的百姓，我愧對領的俸祿。
dalidan.en: I am often ill and long for the fields and village; my district has people driven away, and I am ashamed of my salary.
dalidan.simp: 我身多疾病，思念田园乡里，所治的县邑有流亡的百姓，我愧对领的俸禄。

dalidan.src: 聞道欲來相問訊，西樓望月幾回圓。
dalidan.zh: 聽說你想來探問我，我在西樓望著月亮，不知已圓了幾回。
dalidan.en: I hear you mean to come and ask after me; from the west tower I watch the moon, how many times has it already been full?
dalidan.simp: 听说你想来探问我，我在西楼望着月亮，不知已圆了几回。

oucheng.src: 閒來無事不從容，睡覺東窗日已紅。
oucheng.zh: 閒下來時，沒有什麼事不從容，睡醒時東窗的太陽已經紅了。
oucheng.en: In leisure nothing is done in haste; waking, I find the sun already red at the east window.
oucheng.simp: 闲下来时，没有什么事不从容，睡醒时东窗的太阳已经红了。

oucheng.src: 萬物靜觀皆自得，四時佳興與人同。
oucheng.zh: 靜靜觀察萬物，都能自得其樂，四季的好興致與人相同。
oucheng.en: Watching all things quietly, each finds its own contentment; the delights of the four seasons are shared with others.
oucheng.simp: 静静观察万物，都能自得其乐，四季的好兴致与人相同。

oucheng.src: 道通天地有形外，思入風雲變態中。
oucheng.zh: 道理通達天地，超出有形之外；思緒進入風雲變幻之中。
oucheng.en: The Way reaches through heaven and earth, beyond what has form; thought enters the changing shapes of wind and cloud.
oucheng.simp: 道理通达天地，超出有形之外；思绪进入风云变幻之中。

oucheng.src: 富貴不淫貧賤樂，男兒到此是豪雄。
oucheng.zh: 富貴不能使人迷亂，貧賤也樂在其中，男子漢到了這個地步就是英雄豪傑了。
oucheng.en: Wealth and rank do not lead one astray, and poverty is borne with joy; a man who reaches this point is a hero.
oucheng.simp: 富贵不能使人迷乱，贫贱也乐在其中，男子汉到了这个地步就是英雄豪杰了。

chunxilvhuai.src: 水流花謝兩無情，送盡東風過楚城。
chunxilvhuai.zh: 流水和落花兩者都無情，送走了東風，經過楚地的城。
chunxilvhuai.en: Flowing water and fallen flowers are both without feeling, seeing off the east wind past the city of Chu.
chunxilvhuai.simp: 流水和落花两者都无情，送走了东风，经过楚地的城。

chunxilvhuai.src: 蝴蝶夢中家萬里，杜鵑枝上月三更。
chunxilvhuai.zh: 夢中化蝶，家在萬里之外；杜鵑啼在枝頭，月亮已到三更。
chunxilvhuai.en: In a dream as a butterfly, home is ten thousand li away; the cuckoo cries on the bough, and the moon is at the third watch.
chunxilvhuai.simp: 梦中化蝶，家在万里之外；杜鹃啼在枝头，月亮已到三更。

chunxilvhuai.src: 故園書動經年絕，華髮春催兩鬢生。
chunxilvhuai.zh: 家鄉的書信動不動就一年斷絕，春天催生了我雙鬢的白髮。
chunxilvhuai.en: Letters from home are cut off for a year at a time; spring brings white hair to my temples.
chunxilvhuai.simp: 家乡的书信动不动就一年断绝，春天催生了我双鬓的白发。

chunxilvhuai.src: 自是不歸歸便得，五湖煙景有誰爭。
chunxilvhuai.zh: 其實是自己不肯回去，要回去也就回去了，五湖的煙波景色有誰來爭呢？
chunxilvhuai.en: In truth I will not go back; if I would, I could. Who would contest the misty scenery of the Five Lakes?
chunxilvhuai.simp: 其实是自己不肯回去，要回去也就回去了，五湖的烟波景色有谁来争呢？

dadingyuanzhen.src: 春風疑不到天涯，二月山城未見花。
dadingyuanzhen.zh: 春風好像吹不到這天涯，二月的山城還看不到花。
dadingyuanzhen.en: The spring wind seems not to reach the ends of the earth; in the second month the hill town has seen no flowers.
dadingyuanzhen.simp: 春风好像吹不到这天涯，二月的山城还看不到花。

dadingyuanzhen.src: 殘雪壓枝猶有橘，凍雷驚筍欲抽芽。
dadingyuanzhen.zh: 殘雪壓著枝頭，橘樹上仍有果實；寒冷的雷聲驚動竹筍，快要抽出芽來。
dadingyuanzhen.en: Lingering snow weighs on the branches, yet the tangerine tree still has fruit; cold thunder startles the bamboo shoots, nearly ready to sprout.
dadingyuanzhen.simp: 残雪压着枝头，橘树上仍有果实；寒冷的雷声惊动竹笋，快要抽出芽来。

dadingyuanzhen.src: 夜聞啼雁生鄉思，病入新年感物華。
dadingyuanzhen.zh: 夜裡聽見雁鳴引起思鄉之情，生病進入新年，對萬物的繁華有所感慨。
dadingyuanzhen.en: At night I hear wild geese cry and grow homesick; ill at the start of the new year, I feel the glory of things.
dadingyuanzhen.simp: 夜里听见雁鸣引起思乡之情，生病进入新年，对万物的繁华有所感慨。

dadingyuanzhen.src: 曾是洛陽花下客，野芳雖晚不須嗟。
dadingyuanzhen.zh: 我曾是洛陽花下的賞花客，野花雖然開得晚，也不必嘆息。
dadingyuanzhen.en: I was once a flower-viewer in Luoyang; wild blooms may be late, but there is no need to sigh.
dadingyuanzhen.simp: 我曾是洛阳花下的赏花客，野花虽然开得晚，也不必叹息。

qingmingriduijiu.src: 南北山頭多墓田，清明祭掃各紛然。
qingmingriduijiu.zh: 南北的山頭有很多墓地，清明時節人們各自忙著祭掃。
qingmingriduijiu.en: On hills north and south there are many graveyards, and at Qingming everyone is busy sweeping tombs.
qingmingriduijiu.simp: 南北的山头有很多墓地，清明时节人们各自忙着祭扫。

qingmingriduijiu.src: 紙灰飛作白胡蜨，淚血染成紅杜鵑。
qingmingriduijiu.zh: 紙灰飛起像白色的蝴蝶，淚血染成了紅色的杜鵑。
qingmingriduijiu.en: The ashes of paper fly up like white butterflies; tears of blood dye the cuckoo-azaleas red.
qingmingriduijiu.simp: 纸灰飞起像白色的蝴蝶，泪血染成了红色的杜鹃。

qingmingriduijiu.src: 日落狐狸眠塚上，夜歸兒女笑燈前。
qingmingriduijiu.zh: 日落時狐狸睡在墳塚上，夜裡兒女回家，在燈前說笑。
qingmingriduijiu.en: At sunset foxes sleep on the grave mounds; at night the sons and daughters laugh by the lamp at home.
qingmingriduijiu.simp: 日落时狐狸睡在坟冢上，夜里儿女回家，在灯前说笑。

qingmingriduijiu.src: 人生有酒當須醉，一滴何曾到九泉。
qingmingriduijiu.zh: 人生有酒就應當喝醉，一滴酒哪裡到得了黃泉之下。
qingmingriduijiu.en: In life, when there is wine, one should get drunk; not one drop ever reaches the Yellow Springs below.
qingmingriduijiu.simp: 人生有酒就应当喝醉，一滴酒哪里到得了黄泉之下。
